Dear Editor,

We submit "Domain-robust vision-based force estimation by removing the platform sensor offset" for consideration in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence.

The paper shows that cross-platform degradation of vision-based force estimation is a label-side sensor offset and removes it with a domain-adversarial regularizer, lowering RMSE on the held-out platform by 19.2% relative to the strongest baseline under a preregistered protocol with explicit seed-noise resolution.

The work is not under consideration elsewhere.

Sincerely,
the authors
